category: Branding and wording for each client

history.name: The document's own wording is the project's
history.description: Every line of standing prose the documents emit — their titles, the paragraph that opens each one, the cover's introduction, the closing note about who the ledger was prepared for — can be replaced per project. The defaults are written around the product's name and its one-line description, so they read as being about this product rather than about software in general, and only need replacing when a project wants its own voice.
history.dev_notes: src/wording.mjs holds every default in one place, merged with config.docs per document.
